title: Zaba: a case for clubs
summary: We present several remarks on cardinal coefficients associated with the generalized Baire space for an inaccessible cardinal kappa. Our inquiry originates in the work of van der Vlugt arXiv:2307.14118 . We provide evidence that the appropriate coefficients to consider are those determined by binary relations restricted to a club. In other words, we make a case for the systematic use of clubs.
